findings.quote: A **fuse** or circuit breaker opens the circuit when the current is too large.
findings.problem: Electrical safety is a case named at official curriculum class in dcat-L083 (discuss electrical safety/energy efficiency) and ustet-L124 (electricity safety/efficiency). Efficiency is worked in Examples #10 and #15, but safety has three Core Concept sentences and no worked example. The audit recorded its examples as none, not as not-required. The student never applies the idea, for example why a short circuit or too many appliances on one line makes a fuse open. Core Concept also never says why a large current is a danger (wires heat up and can start a fire), so the example would have no reason to work from.
findings.source: content-checklist.md L18; writer-rules.md lead ruling 1; brief: Electrical safety/energy efficiency, absent, examples none, refs dcat-L083 and ustet-L124 at official curriculum class

findings.quote: The motor changes electrical energy to motion.
